clips.title: The story
paras: Dwarven Outfitters is an introductory survival task in Coldridge Valley offered by Sten Stoutarm. In exchange for culling local wolves and gathering their tough meat for winter rations, fresh recruits are rewarded with sturdy gloves to ward off frostbite in Dun Morogh's biting cold.

The high mountain pass of Coldridge Valley is brutally cold, and unprepared travelers quickly learn that standard kit is no match for the elements. Standing outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm offers a straightforward frontier bargain to new recruits: venture into the snowy drifts, hunt down the prowling wolves, and bring back cuts of tough meat to help supply the outpost. In return, he provides proper cold-weather gloves to ensure young adventurers keep all ten fingers.

While wolves represent a perpetual hazard to dwarven scouts and fledgling gnomes training in the valley, they are also a vital resource. Their meat sustains the garrison stationed at Anvilmar, and culling their numbers keeps the paths between the local encampments somewhat safer. Stoutarm's arrangement serves a double purpose—testing a recruit's ability to handle the local wildlife while stockpiling food for the bitter nights ahead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?
I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.
I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, friend, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
